property_summary: For every call to transfer(from,caddress,_tos,v), the reference contract returns true (call completes) whenever _tos.length > 0 and attempts to invoke transferFrom on the callee for each _tos entry; the mutant requiring _tos.length == 0 causes calls with non-empty _tos to revert, so there exists inputs (non-empty _tos) where the mutant fails but the reference succeeds.
change_summary: Negate the require on _tos.length to require it equals zero, causing different reachable behaviors and likely reverting for non-empty arrays.
